title_en: 2026 AI National University Student Startup Hackathon: Call for Participants
summary: Currently enrolled students at universities participating in the EduTech SoftLab consortium and at universities nationwide may enter, in teams of up to four, the 2026 AI National University Student Startup Hackathon hosted by Hallym University's EduTech SoftLab Project Group. Teams must apply online at https://buly.kr/GP5oiR6 by 17:00 on Wednesday, 11 November 2026. The event takes place on 19–20 November 2026 in the 3rd-floor gymnasium of the Recreation Center at Hallym University, with an online orientation via ZOOM on 16 November 2026.
applies_to: Currently enrolled students (재학생) at universities participating in the EduTech SoftLab consortium and at universities nationwide. Participants enter in teams of up to four people; places are limited to 25 teams (100 people in total). The notice does not state that participation is mandatory.

dates.what: Team activity period begins (360 minutes; on-site advisers, lunch and dinner boxes and late-night snacks provided)
Special lecture (scores tallied and satisfaction survey conducted)

conditions: Only currently enrolled students may participate.
Each team may have at most four members, and places are limited to 25 teams (100 people in total).
Each team must choose one of the five given topics, define a regional problem, and develop an AI (EduTech)-based solution and prototype as a feasible startup item.
Each team's presentation must last no longer than 10 minutes.
Presentation materials must be submitted by 09:30 on 20 November 2026.
Taxes and public charges on prize money are paid by the winners themselves.
An award may not be given if there is no suitable recipient for it.
A certificate of participation is issued.
steps: Choose one of the five topics and form a team of up to four currently enrolled students.
Apply online at https://buly.kr/GP5oiR6 by 17:00 on Wednesday, 11 November 2026.
Attend the online orientation via ZOOM on Monday, 16 November 2026, 19:00–20:00.
Register your team on site between 09:00 and 10:30 on Thursday, 19 November 2026, at the 3rd-floor gymnasium of the Recreation Center, Hallym University.
Attend the hackathon briefing at 10:30 and carry out team development work from 11:00.
Submit your presentation materials by 09:30 on Friday, 20 November 2026 (the notice does not state how or where to submit).
Give your team presentation (within 10 minutes) in Part 1 or Part 2 on 20 November 2026, then attend the special lecture and award ceremony.
For questions, contact Hallym University's EduTech SoftLab Project Group; the contact details are in the original notice.
translation:
Notice: 2026 AI National University Student Startup Hackathon (「2026 AI 활용 전국 대학생 창업 해커톤 대회」)

The EduTech SoftLab Project Group of Hallym University will hold the 「2026 AI National University Student Startup Hackathon」, in which students from universities participating in the Higher Education EduTech SoftLab and from universities nationwide develop and demonstrate AI-based EduTech solutions that solve problems in educational settings.

3. Event overview

A. Event name: 「2026 AI National University Student Startup Hackathon」

B. Dates: Thursday, 19 November – Friday, 20 November 2026
※ Orientation: Monday, 16 November 2026, 19:00–20:00 (ZOOM)

C. Venue: Gymnasium, 3rd floor, Recreation Center, Hallym University

D. Eligibility: Currently enrolled students at universities participating in the EduTech SoftLab consortium and at universities nationwide / up to 4 people per team (25 teams, 100 people in total)

E. Theme: Regional problems: Discover startup ideas using AI (EduTech)

1. Education. Problem area: regional education gaps, learning support, improving access to education. Description: develop customised education startup items that use AI to address regional education gaps (including Gangwon), learning accessibility and individual learning support.

2. Tourism and transport. Problem area: public transport accessibility, mobility, support for the transport-vulnerable. Description: develop startup items that use AI to address problems such as public transport accessibility, travel to tourist sites and the transport-vulnerable in regions including Gangwon.

3. Ageing, care, medical care and welfare. Problem area: growing elderly population, shortage of care workers, access to medical care and welfare. Description: develop AI-based care and daily-living support startup items suited to regional characteristics, responding to the growing elderly population and shortage of care workers in regions including Gangwon.

4. Local commercial districts. Problem area: customer acquisition, sales growth, promotion and marketing, demand forecasting. Description: develop AI-based startup items that help small businesses in regions including Gangwon gain customers, increase sales, serve foreign customers, and with promotion and demand forecasting.

5. Disasters, safety and environment. Problem area: wildfires, heavy rain, heavy snow, mountain accidents, disaster prevention and response. Description: develop AI-based safety and disaster-response startup items that consider regional characteristics such as wildfires, heavy rain, heavy snow and mountain accidents in regions including Gangwon.

※ Each participating team selects one of the five topics above, defines a specific regional problem, derives an AI (EduTech)-based solution and develops a prototype, thereby discovering and refining a feasible startup item.

F. Main schedule

Thursday, 19 November
- 09:00–10:30 (60 min as stated): Participant team registration
- 10:30–10:50 (10 min): Hackathon briefing
- From 11:00 (360 min): Team activities. ※ On-site advisory panel (resolving difficulties and advising on development direction); ※ lunch and dinner boxes provided; ※ late-night snacks provided

Friday, 20 November
- By 09:30: Submission of presentation materials
- 09:30–10:00 (30 min): Break
- 10:00–12:00 (120 min): Presentations [Part 1]. ※ Within 10 minutes per team; ※ 12 teams
- 12:00–13:00 (60 min): Lunch. ※ Lunch box provided
- 13:00–15:10 (130 min): Presentations [Part 2]. ※ Within 10 minutes per team; ※ 13 teams
- 15:10–16:10 (60 min): Special lecture. ※ Tallying of judging scores; ※ satisfaction survey
- 16:10–16:40 (30 min): Awards and group photo

G. Application deadline: Apply online by 17:00 on Wednesday, 11 November 2026 (https://buly.kr/GP5oiR6)

H. Other: A certificate of participation will be issued.

I. Awards (prize money per team)
- Grand Prize (KERIS President's Award): KRW 5,000,000, 1 team
- First Prize (Hallym University President's Award): KRW 3,000,000, 1 team
- Excellence Prize (EduTech SoftLab Project Group Director's Award): KRW 2,000,000, 2 teams
- Special Prize (Hallym University Startup Support Headquarters Director's Award): KRW 1,000,000, 3 teams
※ Taxes and public charges are borne by the award winners.
※ An award may not be given if there is no suitable recipient for it.

4. Inquiries: Hallym University EduTech SoftLab Project Group (the telephone number is given in the original notice).
